panel.intro: Anyone with this code or QR code can confirm the approved figures of this report without signing in.

page.title: Verify a weekly report
page.intro: Enter the code printed on a weekly report, or scan its QR code, to see the approved figures and confirm they have not been altered.
page.invalid: That does not look like a verification code. Codes have 10 letters and numbers.
page.notFound: We could not recognise that code. Check each character and try again.
page.rateLimited: Too many checks. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
page.metaDescription: Check that a ShipLens weekly report was approved and has not been altered since.

integrity.mismatch: These figures do not match the record
integrity.unanchored: This report could not be traced
integrity.chain_broken: The audit record cannot be trusted right now

integrityDetail.verified: The approved total and collection count match what was submitted and approved, and the approval is recorded in an intact audit chain.
integrityDetail.mismatch: The figures on this report differ from the totals recorded when it was submitted and approved. Please treat them with caution.
integrityDetail.unanchored: We could not find the submission and approval events for this report in the audit chain, so its figures cannot be confirmed.
integrityDetail.chain_broken: The audit chain failed its integrity check, so no report can be confirmed until it is restored.

result.anchor: Recorded in the audit chain as event <ltr>#{seq}</ltr>

sealCheck.match: The seal in your link matches the audit chain.
sealCheck.mismatch: The seal in your link does not match. The history of this report may have been rewritten after your link was issued.
sealCheck.not_provided: No seal was included in your link.

chain.empty: The audit chain has no events yet

result.howItWorks: Every change in ShipLens is written to an audit chain in which each event carries a fingerprint of the one before it, so editing or deleting any event breaks the chain. The seal in your link comes from this report's approval event, so it stops matching if the history is ever rewritten.
result.privacy: No personal information is shown on this page.
